data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims outstanding at the opening of 2019 (closing 2018) are shown in the Technical Provisions note. The scanned report pages do not provide a clearly identifiable gross prior-year development (PYD) figure or a gross movement reconciliation that can be unambiguously extracted. Management commentary references remediation activity, rate increases and foreign currency exchange effects but no explicit gross PYD amount was found in the available pages. As a result the opening gross reserve is reported but the PYD movement is not quantified from the source documents provided.

data.data_quality_notes: Document provided as scanned images. Numbers were read visually from tables. Opening gross claims outstanding taken from the Technical Provisions / Claims outstanding table (interpreted as 398,949 -> 398.949m). Gross premiums written 358,907 interpreted as 358.907m. No unambiguous GROSS prior-year development (movement in prior years) figure was found in the provided pages; a claims development triangle and movement tables are present but the scanned quality and layout prevented a reliable numeric extraction of a PYD gross movement. Where narrative quoted net movements, these were not used (per instructions). If higher-resolution pages or the full notes in text form are supplied, a gross PYD figure may be extractable. The claims development triangle appears present (page 29) but its numeric cells were not reliably transcribed from the scanned images for automated PYD calculation.
